pages.text:
The Fermenter turns crops and water into Ethanol, using a little power.
| Crop | Ethanol |
| Sorghum Stalks, Dried Sorghum | 80 mB |
| Wheat, Dried Grain, Potato, Carrot, Beetroot | 50 mB |
| Sugar Cane | 60 mB |
| Sweet Berries | 25 mB |
| Melon Slice | 20 mB |
Each takes 100 mB of water and 10 s (Dried Grain and Dried Sorghum 5 s), and has a 10% chance to leave Bone Meal. Speed and Energy upgrades work.
# Dried Hops
Dried Hops in the additive slot (under the crop) raise the Ethanol of each operation by 20%. One lasts 4 operations.
# Carbon Dioxide
Fermenting gives off Carbon Dioxide, 1 mB for each mB of Ethanol. Set a face to Gas Output to pipe it away through Pressurized Conduits; with no Gas Output face, or once its tank is full, it goes into the air. It never stops the Fermenter.
# Ethanol
A light fuel: 300 HU per mB at up to 900°C in the Fuel Burner (Naphtha is 400 HU at 1,200°C). It also runs the Gas Turbine Array.
